topic: Ghrelin and leptin — the hunger-satiety seesaw
caption:
Did you know your body has a built-in hunger-satiety seesaw? 🤯 Ghrelin and leptin are the two hormones responsible for regulating your appetite. 💡 Here are 5 key facts: 
1️⃣ Ghrelin is produced in the stomach and signals hunger. 
2️⃣ Leptin is produced by fat cells and signals fullness. 
3️⃣ When ghrelin levels are high, you feel hungry. 🍔
4️⃣ When leptin levels are high, you feel full. 🥗
5️⃣ Imbalance between these two hormones can lead to weight issues. ⚖️
